what: Executed notebooks pulled from the Kaggle push history, outputs intact.
why: Versions 7, 9 and 12 are the U-Net line-emission lineage leading to V12, the project's reference model. Keeping the notebooks themselves -- not just extracted figures -- means each version's code, configuration and printed output can be read together and diffed against the others.
note: These are the notebooks AS EXECUTED on Kaggle. They predate the noise clip (bab16d0) and the signal mask (8f4da16), so every moment number inside them is on the original unmasked metric and is not comparable to anything scored after those commits. See ../../RUNS.md.
v12_checkpoint: v12 wrote unet_line_emission_continuum_best.pth (epoch 28, val_loss 0.0034) into /kaggle/working, so the weights are in Kaggle's Output for that version. Attach it as an Input and notebook 05 section 4 restores it, which is how V12 gets re-scored under the current metric.
